# dbt-labs/dbt-core v2.0.5

Changes since v2.0.4, released 2026-09-18.

## New

- Telemetry for LSP language features, diagnostics, and dbt commands
- Parse-phase progress bar, and attribute the post-parse tail
- Accept optional ResultStore in base-context builders
- Add AWS Databricks Unity Catalog reads to Lake Compute
- Support EVERY and ON UPDATE refresh schedules

- Handle BigQuery partition field mismatches
- Fix
- Support kwargs in modules.re functions
- Apply connection priority and maximum_bytes_billed to query jobs
- Harden `redact_credentials`
- Copy config.group onto source and singular tests
- Set tags on operation nodes so v1 can discover hooks via --use-v2-parser
- Resolve adapter metadata and guard environment setup

- Update CONTRIBUTING.md for dbt-labs/dbt repo rename (#16341)
- Generalize CONTRIBUTING.md from dbt Core to dbt
- Generalize CONTRIBUTING.md from dbt Core to dbt (#16328)

## Also in this release

- [static-analysis] Duplicate column name analysis on queries
- Update README to remove beta warning for dbt v2.0
